notes: PC-only dependency scout for the engine RTTI bases of spAnimation; PS2 deliberately deferred.

classes.summary: PC abstract identity, vtable, null factory/clone, protected copy slot and the mismatch between engine RTTI and spAnimation physical C++ layout are known; copy body, abstract slot and fields remain open.

evidence.observation: spController is factory-less, has an eight-slot vtable ending in the common abstract body, a protected copy thunk and an engine RTTI base of spSubController.
The eight-slot controller vtable differs from the seven-slot spAnimation vtable, whose destructor returns directly through the spBaseObject body; engine RTTI base is not a physical-layout guarantee.

classes.summary: PC abstract identity, vtable, null factory/clone and base no-payload copy are known; exact layout, original abstract method name and callers remain open.

evidence.observation: spSubController is factory-less, uses the base no-payload copy and has an eight-slot vtable ending in the same abstract body as spController.
